name: rust-identity-module-move
body: `solution.component.rust-crate-identity` is implemented-by `rust.apg-rustfrontend.identity.package_prefix_map` and `rust.apg-rustfrontend.identity.crate_prefix`. The Rust frontend crate is a single-target binary crate rooted at `src/main.rs`, so the Module `rust.apg-rustfrontend` and `rust.apg-rustfrontend.main` are preserved and every other unit carries a module segment in its Rust FQN. The crate decomposition splits the crate into ten sibling `mod` files, placing the two crate-identity functions in the `identity` module; `solution.container.rust-frontend` is implemented-by the Module `rust.apg-rustfrontend`.
